notes.title: From Hell... New Ending — Aijin: Major Version Update
notes.content:
[h1]From Hell... New Ending — Aijin: Major Version Update[/h1]
Aijin just rolled out a massive update today! Here's what's new:
[b]New Content[/b]
[u][b]1: Enhanced "Sanity" Mechanics
Including:
①Sanity will gradually decrease over time
②Press B to recover sanity
③New sanity-based features that unlock new endings
④Map changes based on sanity levels
2: New Maps "From Hell" and "Walls of Flesh"
3: 8 Brand New BGM Tracks
4: 7 New Monsters with Unique Mechanics
①"Dismembered Crawler": Slow-moving, dangerous in groups, easily surrounded
②"Headless Runner": Normal movement, stationary during breathing, persistent tracking
③"Unholy Triangular Mark": Immobile, must be constantly watched in light
④"Pulsating Heart": From an unknown organism, constantly throbbing
⑤"Demon Head": Hidden in an abyss, cannot be stared at
⑥"Blood Room": Appears in random locations, contains supplies
⑦"Her": ???
5: New Storyline Progressions in GALGAME Endings
6: New Ending "Walls of Flesh"
7: New Ending "Reality and Fantasy"
8: More Hints and Guidance
9: New Map "Sunset Horizon"[/b][/u]
[b]
[/b]Beyond new content, we've optimized UI and map elements.
[u][b]1: Map Performance Optimization
2: Inventory Screen Update
3: Exit Screen Redesign
4: Main Menu Refresh[/b][/u]
Stay tuned for upcoming multiplayer functionality in the next version!

notes.title: New patch about Fix localization issues and UI compatibility
notes.content:

In this patch, I have comprehensively fixed all localization issues and UI compatibility problems with localized text.

To ensure a sufficiently scary atmosphere, the pixelation filter is now forcibly enabled.
The player's flashlight is now brighter.

notes.title: "Lover: Aijin" Content Update — 2025/3/4
notes.content:
[h1][b]Join the Pixel Fear! — "Lover: Aijin" Content Update — 2025/3/4
[/b][/h1]
[u]I'm very pleased to have received feedback and suggestions from many players. In this updated version, I've added the following new content and fixed several bugs[/u]
[h1][b]New Content Update[/b][/h1]
[h3][i]①The game will now be played with a pixel filter, which can be toggled on or off in the settings.
②Each chapter now has guiding text to help players progress through the main story.
③Fixed some light sources on the map
④The game will now use "Medium" quality settings by default
⑤Battery power has been greatly increased
⑥The "Female Ghost" will no longer kill players directly, but will instead linger behind the player.
⑦Both the "Female Ghost" and "Little Girl" will now have audio cues before they appear
⑧The "Little Girl" is now more threatening and will reduce sanity when within a radius of 50.[/i][/h3]
[b][h1]Bug Fixes[/h1][/b]
[h3][i]①Further improvements to player perspective
②Fixed bugs where surveillance cameras couldn't be opened or operated
③Fixed bugs where the flashlight couldn't be toggled in specific situations
④Noise filter overlay has been removed from player view[/i][/h3]
[h2]This is all the content for this update. Thank you everyone for your feedback on the game.
Mangolotis[/h2]

notes.title: Regarding content updates and bug fies-2025/3/3
notes.content:
[h1][b]First, I apologize for needing to update again, but this update may affect the gameplay experience, so it's necessary to make the following bug fixes and content updates:[/b][/h1]
Regarding content updates—
[u]①Now you can pass through doors when they're open, and the door opening speed has been increased
②Player's viewpoint will no longer be off due to walking and running
③The save point on the rooftop has been removed
④Added camera shake when the player is running
⑤Fixed viewpoints inside closets where players can hide[/u]
Regarding bug fixes—
[u]①Fixed a bug where camera view couldn't be moved immediately after loading a save
②Now sanity medication can be saved when loading a save
③Fixed a bug where players couldn't return via the rooftop after getting the rooftop key[/u]
Regarding route changes in the update—
[h3]Now you can proceed directly to the Backrooms ending after completing the first chapter
The Truth ending has been moved to the Heavenly Stems and Earthly Branches puzzle[/h3]

[h2]Explanation and description of the game's gameplay
First, I apologize that as a horror game, if it's not "scary" enough or doesn't have enough "JUMP SCARES," it might not provide the entertainment effect some expect. I've already adjusted the lighting in previous versions and reset the light sources, so players now have enough light to play smoothly.
Second, as a 3D adaptation of a sandbox + RPGMAKER style map, the horror game compatibility isn't very high. I deeply apologize for providing players with a maze-like map, which may be one of the main reasons for player fatigue, but the game has already been released, and the initial design concept was like this, so it cannot be modified.
Regarding the explanation for some of the inexpensive UI—personally created independent UI, with most player feedback being about the inventory UI. I hope you can understand the cost constraints of a small-scale game priced at 17 yuan. I apologize for not providing a perfect artistic experience.
If there are areas that need modification or improvement, please feel free to suggest them, and I will do my best within my capabilities.
Thank you to all players—[/h2]

notes.title: 重大BUG，功能性修复与更新——Important fixed review of bug conception
notes.content:
[h1][b]Major BUG, Functional Fixes and Updates—Important fixed review of bug conception
[/b][/h1]
Dear players,
[b]Hello, after the game has been online for one day, I have collected several serious bugs and missing features that affect gameplay. I have fixed these issues in the newly uploaded version based on your feedback.[/b]
[u]Moving forward, I will continue to listen to players' voices and actively fix reported bugs. Additionally, please allow me to briefly mention about the ending branches:—[/u]
[h2]The trigger condition for Ending #1 is—Sewer
The trigger condition for Ending #2 is—Rooftop Key
The trigger condition for Ending #3 is—Bridge Passage[/h2]
[b]I hope to give players who haven't completed the game some tips on unlocking endings. I wish everyone a wonderful experience after completing all endings!
Below are the bugs fixed and new features in the updated version:[/b]
[h2][b]
①New Feature—Players can now load their last save position from the main interface (but collected items won't be saved)
—Players can now return to the main interface by pressing ESC to exit the game
②Fixed Bugs—In Chapter 1, encountering the woman in red no longer causes the player to get stuck or become immobile.
—Further optimization of the inventory interface—Now you can close all pop-up menus simultaneously by pressing Tab
[/b][/h2]

notes.title: 诚挚游戏发行前评鉴-Sincere Game Pre-Release Evaluation
notes.content:
Due to [b][h1]STEAM release time coinciding with the STEAM New Product Festival[/h1][/b], and because of the previous [h1][b]store review delay[/b][/h1], there is a requirement that "Coming Soon" must be displayed for at least two weeks before releasing the game. We are currently coordinating with customer service, and the [h2][b]latest game release date is tentatively set for 3/5[/b][/h2]. We sincerely apologize for not being able to deliver the game to everyone on time on 2/25. We equally want every player to experience the most complete and best version of the game at present.
[h3][b]I would also like to invite review groups or livestreamers who enjoy playing similar games to contact me at [u][h2][b]mangolotis1@gmail.com[/b][/h2][/u]. I will send you a CD key so you can play the game in advance. Thank you very much.[/b][/h3]
